threat_event: Attacker signs in to the remote access portal with the owner's reused password and stops the hypochlorite feed or changes pump setpoints
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist targeting water systems (credential stuffing)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal uses a password only; the password is reused from a breached shopping account and saved in the phone app; the relief operator shares the login; no review of portal sign-ins
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 portal; SYS-01 panel; BP-01 disinfection
existing_controls: Daily site visit and grab sample; mechanical stroke cap on the chlorine pump; low-residual alarm to the dialer
treatment_plan: Turn on app-based MFA for every portal account; new unique passphrase in a password manager; named account for the relief operator; remove the saved password; monthly log review (AU-6)

threat_event: Integrator's always-enabled portal account is misused (integrator's own systems compromised or a former integrator employee) to change PLC logic or setpoints
threat_source: Cybercriminal (supply chain) or former insider at the integrator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator account always enabled with setpoint and program rights; password only; no session approval or notice; 2 of 3 sign-ins in 90 days unexplained; no security terms in the agreement
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 portal; SYS-01 panel; BP-01 and BP-02
existing_controls: Portal records each integrator session (never reviewed)
treatment_plan: Disable the integrator account except during sessions the owner approves; require MFA on it; keep a maintenance log; ask the integrator about the 2 unexplained sign-ins; add remote access, incident notice, and program-copy terms to the agreement

threat_event: Attacker reaches the cellular router's administration page with the default label password and changes its settings or opens a path to the PLC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default administrator password; remote web administration was on until 2026-07-23; firmware from 2019
treatment_plan: Replace the default password and update the firmware during a planned visit; record required router settings

threat_event: PLC program or HMI project is lost or corrupted (surge, lightning, hardware failure, or a malicious logic change) and the owner holds no current copy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrator holds the only current program (2023 version); the owner's 2019 USB stick is out of date; no restore steps
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 panel; BP-02 supply and pressure
existing_controls: Plant can run by hand at the panel
treatment_plan: Get the current program and HMI project from the integrator; keep one copy on an encrypted USB drive in the home fire safe and one in the file account; refresh after every change; write restore and verification steps with the integrator

threat_event: Owner is suddenly unavailable (illness, injury, or storm travel) and nobody else can run the plant by hand or reach the portal, so loss of disinfection goes uncorrected beyond 4 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; manual settings not written down; relief agreement covers planned days off only; relief operator never drilled on hand operation
existing_controls: Relief operator agreement for days off; dialer calls the relief operator second
treatment_plan: One-page manual-operation sheet in the well house; emergency coverage clause in the relief agreement; named portal account for the relief operator; sealed access envelope with the owner's attorney; one walkthrough a year

threat_event: Phishing or malware on the laptop, used in the administrator account, steals saved billing and email credentials or encrypts files, including the residual spreadsheet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Daily administrator use; no security training; spreadsheet only on the laptop
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; built-in antivirus; automatic updates; MFA on billing and email
treatment_plan: Standard daily account; password manager; free cybersecurity course for small water systems; keep the spreadsheet in the file account

threat_event: Billing SaaS vendor breach exposes customer portal user names and passwords
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor's controls not reviewed; contract breach-notice terms unknown
existing_controls: Vendor MFA for the administrator; card data stays with the processor
treatment_plan: Request the vendor's SOC 2 report; confirm the contract requires breach notice within Florida's 10-day third-party agent window

threat_event: A cyber-caused loss of disinfection is not recognized as a reporting trigger, so the 4-hour treatment clock, the next-business-day state notice, and the 24-hour Tier 1 consultation are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan; the public notice routine lists only bacteriological results, main breaks, and hurricanes; the 141.405 clock is not written anywhere
existing_controls: Primacy agency after-hours number known from 2024
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; add the cyber trigger and the 4-hour clocks to the well house binder; walk through with the relief operator

threat_event: Public notice cannot reach every household within 24 hours because the only contact list is in the billing SaaS and email is unavailable
threat_source: Service outage or the incident itself
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No offline contact list; 26 households have no phone or email on file
existing_controls: Owner can hand-deliver to 138 homes in about 3 hours; posting sites at the subdivision entrance
treatment_plan: Monthly offline export of customer contacts printed for the well house binder; list of posting sites

threat_event: Owner relies on the anomaly alerts and misses a real problem the model did not flag; the vendor uses process data to train its models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature turned on without review; no validation; click-through terms allow model training
existing_controls: Daily site visit and grab sample continue; hardwired dialer alarms independent of the portal
treatment_plan: Keep alerts advisory only; never skip a site visit or grab sample because of them; opt out of model training if offered; log each alert and the check made (P10)

threat_event: Hurricane cuts power and cellular service for several days; remote view is lost and only Well 1 can run on the generator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generator sized for Well 1 and one high-service pump; cellular service needed for the portal and dialer
existing_controls: Portable generator with transfer switch; fuel on hand; 2024 experience; precautionary boil water notice template
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Owner stays at or near the well house during a hurricane warning and follows the hurricane checklist

threat_event: Intruder enters the well house and changes settings at the HMI, which has no login
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HMI setpoint screens have no login
existing_controls: Fence, lock, door alarm to the dialer; daily visit
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. HMI login is added when the default passwords are changed (R-003 and R-013 work with the integrator)

threat_event: Known vulnerabilities in the 2019 router and HMI firmware are exploited because no one tracks advisories
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware never updated; no inventory of models and versions; no advisory subscription
existing_controls: Panel not reachable from the internet except through the vendor relay
treatment_plan: Record models and firmware versions; subscribe to CISA advisories; update router and HMI firmware with the integrator; change PLC and HMI default passwords

threat_event: Compliance records (residual log, lowest daily residual, notices) are lost, so the owner cannot show 5 or 10 years of records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Residual spreadsheet only on the laptop; paper log at the well house
existing_controls: Paper operating log; lab results in the lab portal and email
treatment_plan: Keep the spreadsheet in the file account with version history; scan the paper log monthly

threat_event: A consumer AI chat assistant drafts a customer notice with wrong health-effects language, or customer data is pasted into it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Free consumer AI tool used for customer letters in 2025; no rule on its use
existing_controls: No customer list was ever pasted in
treatment_plan: POL-01 9.5: public notices only from the primacy agency template; no customer data in consumer AI tools (P10)
